newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks slip at noon as investors stay out.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks slip at noon as investors stay out.

text.p: Pakistani stocks slipped at midday on Monday on lack of interest from investors and institutions worried about the economy and dealers said the index would trade in a narrow range in the near term.
"Synthetic stocks are slightly up on hopes that local polyester fibre prices would be raised," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "But overall sentiment is weak because investors remain on the sidelines."
The index fell 1.95 points, or 0.13 percent, to 1,540.40 at noon. Losers led gainers 139 to 50. Hub Power fell 0.50 rupees to 37.20. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
